description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing bank accounts, exposing endpoints for listing all accounts, retrieving an account by ID, creating a new account, and updating account balances.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for bank account management, including list, retrieve, create, and update operations.

methods.name: getAllAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all bank accounts by querying the repository.

methods.name: getAccountById
methods.description: Fetches a specific account by ID, throws ResourceNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account with provided details, returns the created account wrapped in ResponseEntity.

methods.name: updateBalance
methods.description: Updates an account's balance by adding the specified amount, identified by account ID.
